commits.messageBody:
FileElementCollectionItem::localName() only ever called setText() for
a non-root directory item inside the success path of loading and
parsing its qet_directory metadata file. If docu.load_file() failed
for any reason -- the file is missing, malformed, or (per the
Windows + special-character reports in bugtracker #332) can't be
opened at all due to a path-encoding issue -- the branch did nothing,
leaving the tree item's text unset. Since text() starts null on a
freshly created item, that produces exactly the reported symptom: the
folder shows up with a completely blank label.

Track the resolved name in a local rather than calling setText()
inline, pass the item's own raw name (m_path) as the fallback argument
to NamesList::name() (the same fallback-chain convention already used
by ElementsLocation::name() elsewhere), and fall back to m_path
directly whenever qet_directory couldn't be loaded or parsed at all.
Either way the folder now always displays something -- its own
directory name at worst -- instead of silently going blank.

This doesn't chase down the exact platform-specific reason
qet_directory fails to open on Windows with accented/special
characters in the path (couldn't reproduce that in this environment,
no Windows host available) -- it makes the app robust to that failure
regardless of its root cause, which is what actually fixes the
reported "folders without names" symptom.

Fixes https://qelectrotech.org/bugtracker/view.php?id=332
commits.messageHeadline: Fall back to the raw directory name when qet_directory can't be read

title: Fix folders showing with no name in the elements panel
